responsibility: Implements the middle-end regimplification helpers used after the main gimplifier to force expressions and repaired statements back into valid GIMPLE operand form. It expands arbitrary trees into temporary-producing gimple sequences according to a supplied predicate, inserts those sequences before or after a statement iterator, and traverses existing statements to regimplify invalid operands, special-casing calls, conditions, switches, asm operands, and LHS/RHS interactions when transformations have broken canonical GIMPLE form.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the narrower post-gimplification repair interface declared in gcc/gimplify-me.h; unlike the main lowering logic in gcc/gimplify.c, it regimplifies already-existing statements and forces individual expressions back into valid GIMPLE form after transformations have broken operand constraints.
